data.description: RED task. In applier.create_one(), before AcliClient.create_issue(), call AcliClient.search_issues('labels = "dso-id:<local_id>"'). On miss, proceed with create. Budget guard: if (rest_calls + 1) > 200, append to deferred_creates and return without searching or creating. On hit: skip create_issue() call (mapping write and event emit are task-2). Unit tests assert search precedes create on miss path, budget guard defers at 200 calls, hit skips create_issue.
data.title: Add JQL dedup guard to applier.create_one miss path with budget deferral
